methodology.purpose: Recent-issues discovery and held-out answer benchmark for Spain.
methodology.important: These are discussion hypotheses, not factual labels; evidence must be checked independently.
methodology.deduplication: Claims were written as new propositions and should still pass semantic family-collision tooling.
